items.label: SUPERIOR SUPPORT FOR PLANTS
items.value: This 4 pack peony support cages provide reliable support for your garden. Each set includes a sturdy grid top attached to 4 leg supports, offering greater stability compared to common 3 leg supports. Top multi-layer concentric ring design helps evenly distribute the weight of flower heads, effectively preventing peonies from flopping or breaking. The peony cages and supports keep your carefully nurtured plants standing upright and thriving

items.label: STURDY & RUST-PROOF PLASTIC STRUCTURE
items.value: Made of 8mm diameter thick plastic rods, these plant supports for outdoor plants are strong, durable and bend-resistant, plus they won’t rust like metal options. The surface of the plastic support rod has a matte touch to achieve anti-slip properties, which can maintain maximum stability at contact points. Green plant support rings blend naturally into your garden providing a beautiful and practical support system

items.label: ADJUSTABLE HEIGHT FOR CUSTOMIZABLE SUPPORT
items.value: At 11.8 inches in diameter and 25 inches in maximum height for each peony rings support, ideal for most bushy plants, vine plants and potted plants indoor. This ring can be fixed at different heights on the support rod, and customized according to the different heights and growth stages of the plant. With the help of the garden support hoops, ensure that they grow upright, maintain their shape and full of vitality

items.label: SIMPLE ASSEMBLY & COMPACT STORAGE
items.value: Setting up these peony cages is quick and straightforward. Simply attach the 4 leg supports to the groove of the grid top according to the instructions. Insert 4 ground plugs at least 4 inches into the base soil around your plant for secure anchoring against wind and rain. In the off-season, these lightweight plastic peony stakes can be easily disassembled, making transportation and storage more effortless, saving storage space

items.label: VERSATILE USE FOR HEALTHY UPRIGHT GROWTH
items.value: Designed to promote healthy growth, these grid plant supports offer essential early-season stability for flowers and plants. They encourage taller, straighter growth while preventing flopping, making them an excellent choice for peonies, roses, hydrangeas, tomatoes, begonias, and other heavy-blossomed or tall-stemmed varieties
